text:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up: AstraTech sent an RFI. Key asks: private VPC deployment in eu-central-1, HSM BYOK, SOC2+ISO attestation, 12-month audit log retention, and a short POC for embeddings+chat. They want pricing for Reserved vs On-demand and a capability matrix.

Ravi (Solutions): Got it. Need target QPS and sample prompt set. Propose POC scope: private cluster + HSM-sim, perf at 50/150/300 QPS, quality evals on their prompts, and SIEM export test. Est. 9 business days.

Astra-bot: Uploaded file "astratech_rfi_v1.xlsx" to thread.

Elena (Security): I'll answer RFI sections: KMS lifecycle, access controls, audit exports. Note: exporting token-level content requires DPA amendment and customer consent. We'll attach pen-test summary and SOC2 snapshot.

Omar (Product): Recommend int8 embed model for latency/cost tradeoff and fp16 for accuracy tests. I'll add model-variant guidance to the matrix.

Ken (Legal): If they want subcontractor lists or content exports we need NDA amendment and DPA changes. Also flag retention >180 days.

Maya (Sales): Action items: Ravi -> finalize POC runbook; Elena -> RFI answers + attachments; Omar -> capability matrix model guidance; Ken -> DPA/NDA notes. I'll send consolidated packet by Friday.

Ravi (Solutions): Quick infra snippet for infra:
```
deploy:
  region: eu-central-1
  mode: private
  nodes: 5
  kms: hsm-sim
```
Maya (Sales): Thanks team — keep updates here.
